integrity: Analytic proof of the full large-deviation principle and independent finite enumeration are provided. Previously published scalar and typical-scale observations are credited, not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Conditional joint large-deviation law for pairs whose two compositions equal a common constant; not all commuting pairs. Exact finite formula is proved; no sharp subexponential total prefactor or central limit theorem is asserted. Literature-priority uncertainty remains; independent validation not performed.
title: Joint large deviations of image ranks for mutually annihilating full transformations
